purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: The Government of Maharashtra Dhule district site identifies the District Superintendent of Land Records, Dhule, and links the state Mahabhunakasha portal for land maps, along with MahaBhumi for land records and property cards. This is a local land-record/cadastral office and service route; it does not establish vector geometry coverage at the WUP point. The official district source points to Mahabhunakasha maps, but the anonymous viewer page could not be inspected because the page reader encountered a redirect loop. No public feature schema or safe geometry response was verified; no plot-number or property-card lookup was submitted.
